title: Standard for the Transmission of IP Datagrams over IEEE 802 Networks
summary: Specifies a standard way to carry IP datagrams and ARP requests and replies over IEEE 802 networks, so that implementations are compatible and interoperable. It was an Internet standard and replaces RFC 948.

eli5.summary: It tells how to put Internet packets into the envelopes that local office networks use, so different brands of equipment understand each other.

questions: how are ip datagrams sent over ieee 802
what is ip encapsulation on ieee 802 networks
